source.name: @heroui/styles
source.citationNote: Component measurements are transcribed from the pinned component CSS listed above (tier-2/3 transcription). Tailwind v4 default spacing/type scale is used for class-based values (px-3 = 12px, text-sm = 14px) — Tailwind v4 default spacing multiplies 0.25rem and text sizes are fixed rem values.

button.source: heroui-button.css: .button (h-10 md:h-9, px-4, gap-2, rounded-3xl, text-sm font-medium), .button--sm (h-9 md:h-8, px-3), .button--lg (h-11 md:h-10, text-base), .button:active (scale 0.97), utilities: status-focused (ring-2 ring-offset-2)

card.source: heroui-card.css: .card (p-4, gap-3, shadow-surface, border-radius: min(32px, var(--radius-3xl))), .card__title (text-sm leading-6 font-medium), .card__description (text-sm leading-5 text-muted), variants .card--default/secondary/tertiary/transparent

input.source: heroui-input.css: .input (rounded-field, px-3 py-2, text-base sm:text-sm, shadow-field, border-width: var(--field-border-width)=0, hover bg-field-hover, focus status-focused-field ring-2 + bg-field-focus)

chip.source: heroui-chip.css: .chip (rounded-2xl, px-2 py-0.5, text-xs leading-5 font-medium, gap-0.5), .chip--sm (px-1 py-0), .chip--lg (px-3 py-1 text-sm)

badge.source: heroui-badge.css: .badge (min-h-7 min-w-7 rounded-3xl text-xs, border 1px solid var(--background)), .badge--sm (min-h-4 min-w-4 rounded-xl text-[10px]), .badge--lg (min-h-8 min-w-8 rounded-2xl text-sm)

tabs.source: heroui-tabs.css: .tabs__list-container (bg-default, border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2.5)), .tabs__list (p-1), .tabs__tab (h-8 rounded-3xl px-4 text-sm font-medium text-muted), .tabs__indicator (bg-segment shadow-surface rounded-3xl, transition 250ms ease-out-fluid), .tabs--secondary (.tabs__indicator h-0.5 bg-accent, border-b border-border), .tabs__panel (p-2, mt-4 horizontal)

skeleton.source: heroui-skeleton.css: .skeleton (rounded-sm bg-surface-tertiary/70), .skeleton--shimmer (::after gradient sweep, animate-skeleton 2s linear infinite), .skeleton--pulse (animate-pulse)

tooltip.source: heroui-tooltip.css: .tooltip (max-w-xs bg-overlay p-2 text-xs, border-radius: min(32px, var(--radius-xl)), box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay))

progress.source: heroui-progress-bar.css: .progress-bar__track (h-2 rounded-sm bg-default), .progress-bar__fill (bg accent rounded-sm, width transition 300ms ease-out), label/output (text-sm font-medium tabular-nums)

switch.source: heroui-switch.css: .switch__control (md 40x20 rounded-xl, sm 32x16 rounded-lg, lg 48x24 rounded-xl), .switch__thumb (md 22x16 rounded-lg bg-white, sm 16.5x12 rounded-md, lg 27.5x20 rounded-xl; checked: bg-accent-foreground text-accent)

checkbox.source: heroui-checkbox.css: .checkbox__control (size-4 rounded-md bg-field shadow-field, ::before bg-accent on selected), checkmark icon (size-2.5 stroke-[2.5px] text-accent-foreground)

modal.source: heroui-modal.css: .modal__dialog (bg-overlay shadow-overlay p-6, border-radius: min(32px, var(--radius-3xl))), sizes max-w-xs/sm/md/lg, .modal__backdrop (bg-backdrop)

avatar.source: heroui-avatar.css: .avatar (size-10 rounded-3xl bg-default), .avatar--sm (size-8 rounded-2xl), .avatar--lg (size-12 rounded-3xl, fallback text-base)

typeScale.source: Tailwind CSS v4 default font-size/line-height scale as used by the pinned component CSS (text-xs 12/16, text-sm 14/20, text-base 16/24, text-lg 18/28, text-xl 20/28, text-2xl 24/32, text-3xl 30/36, text-4xl 36/40)

spacingScale.source: Tailwind CSS v4 default spacing scale (0.25rem base) as used by the pinned component CSS

font.note: HeroUI default font family. Bundled in flutter/ui/assets/fonts (Inter v4.1, rsms/inter).
